title: Two Little Boys in Oversized Hats by Crib, 1958 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black-and-white home snapshot from April 1958 featuring two young boys wearing matching oversized caps. In the foreground, a toddler in a dark plaid collared shirt looks attentively at the camera, while his infant sibling stands in a wooden crib or playpen, clutching the top railing with both hands. The print features decorative scalloped deckle edges with an 'APR • 58' processing stamp along the top border.
